query: Civiqs daily tracker Trump approval latest

results.content:
Only eight states give Trump an approval rating above 50% in the latest Civiqs tracking data. His approval is highest in Wyoming at 57%, followed by North Dakota at 56% and Oklahoma at 54%. Hawaii gives him his lowest rating at 19%.

Nationally, the same tracker places Trump at 36% approval and 59% disapproval.

results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. results.content:
The data comes from Civiqs’ rolling online tracking poll of 118,886 registered voters. A Newsweek analysis compares Trump’s approval rating on July 22, 2026, with where it stood on January 20, 2025, the first day of his second term, with net approval calculated as 'approve' minus 'disapprove.'

Nationally, Trump receives 38 percent approval and 57 percent disapproval, leaving him 19 points underwater overall.
